name: bodyweight elevated heel squat
description: A squat with the heels raised on a small platform, shifting more work to the quads and allowing a deeper knee bend.
instructions: Place your heels on a small plate or wedge, feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Bend your knees and sink down with your chest tall.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
